answers.core:
There is already so much information to learn about a game engine, and the UI should be careful not to imply incorrect information. The current UI does worse than no information by stating partial information, implying a restriction that does not exist.

 It could also make the UI more readable at a glance, separating information to the fields where it is relevant.
answers.workaround: This is just a QOL UI change, and requires no work around.
